details:
Different Views of Space – Project Description

Our project is an educational podcast about NASA's Perseverance rover and its mission on Mars. Through our podcast, we share interesting facts about the rover, its scientific instruments, the rocks it studies, and the samples it collects.

We researched real NASA information, photographs, and scientific data to create our content. We love writing stories, so we chose a podcast as a creative way to share what we learned.

Our goal is to make space exploration fun and easy to understand, especially for younger children. We want to inspire them to ask questions, investigate, and discover more about the universe.

Our project combines science, research, writing, and communication. We worked as a team, sharing ideas and choosing interesting information to make our podcast educational, entertaining, and accessible to everyone!
